name: NextUp Rewatch
description: Filters stalled completed series and dead-end specials from Next Up when rewatching is active, while seamlessly preserving active rewatches.
overview: Smart Next Up filter for rewatched TV series

versions.changelog:
- Add PromoteActiveRewatches setting (enabled by default) to align Next Up LastPlayedDate of active rewatch episodes with the series' latest watch date
- Ensure client apps (such as Moonfin) sort active rewatch series to the top of Continue Watching instead of sinking them by their historical first-watch date
- Preserve Played status in Next Up response while ensuring proper queue positioning

- Add ForceEnableRewatching setting (enabled by default) to force enableRewatching=true server-side on /Shows/NextUp requests
- Support third-party clients lacking a client-side rewatching toggle (Moonfin, Swiftfin, Infuse)
- Clean up stalled completed series automatically while preserving ongoing rewatches

- Support compressed responses (gzip, brotli, deflate) used by Smart TV (webOS) clients
- Fix issue where TV clients receiving compressed /Shows/NextUp payload were bypassing the filter

- Initial release: filter stalled completed series and dead-end specials from Next Up
- Client-agnostic server middleware filtering /Shows/NextUp
- Plugin configuration page in Jellyfin Dashboard
